_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Lexdale Witch Trials#000.src: You should follow the creature before it gets away!
Lexdale Witch Trials#000.dst: ¡Deberías seguir a esa criatura antes de que escape!

Lexdale Witch Trials#001.src: See what's going on in the center of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#001.dst: Averigua qué pasa en el centro de {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#002.src: We have an enemy amongst our own in {p}! This witch's illegal practice of magic threatens us!
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.dst: ¡Tenemos un enemigo entre los nuestros en {p}! ¡La magia ilegal de esta bruja nos amenaza!
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#003.src: Ms. Amira's home was found to be plagued by spreading Decay! We must kill the witch to protect our sanctity!
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.dst: ¡La casa de la señora Amira está plagada de Decadencia! ¡Hay que matar a la bruja para proteger nuestra santidad!
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#004.src: WAIT! Let me GO already! I told you what was happening!
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.dst: ¡ESPERAD! ¡SOLTADME de una vez! ¡Ya os dije lo que pasaba!
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#005.src: The deceit of your dark magic won't work, Ms. Amira. Go quietly- leave us in peace!
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.dst: Sus engaños de magia oscura no funcionarán, señora Amira. Váyase en silencio- ¡déjenos en paz!
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#006.src: SHUT UP ALREADY! You can't just single people out like this!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.dst: ¡CÁLLATE YA! ¡No puedes señalar así a la gente!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#007.src: Just hear me out for a second! It's not me, something infected my home! That's the reason it was so dark!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.dst: ¡Escúchame un segundo! ¡No soy yo, algo infectó mi casa! ¡¡Por eso estaba tan oscura!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#008.src: My basement, some outlandish thing dug into it! Wherever it went, the area withered and decayed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#008.dst: ¡Mi sótano, algo extrañísimo se abrió paso hasta él! ¡Por donde pasaba, todo se marchitaba y se pudría!
Lexdale Witch Trials#008.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#009.src: There's proof in my house that it wasn't me! It's the one that's decayed and barren! You'll see if you LOOK, you gorehound!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#009.dst: ¡En mi casa está la prueba de que no fui yo! ¡Es esa la que está podrida y yerma! ¡¡Lo verás si MIRAS, sanguinario!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#009.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#010.src: Quit with the insults! We'll delay for now- If there's no proof of the witch's innocence she will be executed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#010.dst: ¡Basta de insultos! Lo aplazaremos por ahora- ¡Si no hay prueba de su inocencia, la bruja será ejecutada!
Lexdale Witch Trials#010.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#011.src: Explore the basement of the decayed and barren house.
Lexdale Witch Trials#011.dst: Explora el sótano de la casa podrida y yerma.

Lexdale Witch Trials#012.src: Follow the creature down the tunnels.
Lexdale Witch Trials#012.dst: Sigue a la criatura por los túneles.

Lexdale Witch Trials#013.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#013.dst: Sigue a la criatura desde el túnel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#014.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#014.dst: Sigue a la criatura desde el túnel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#015.src: ...Further... intruders...? You are not of the worms... the parasites?
Lexdale Witch Trials#015.dst: ...¿Más... intrusos...? ¿No eres de los gusanos... los parásitos?
Lexdale Witch Trials#015.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#016.src: Another stranger... You must have witnessed the tunnels. They blight the stone, wither the roots, make lifeless the land...
Lexdale Witch Trials#016.dst: Otro forastero... Habrás visto los túneles. Agostan la piedra, marchitan las raíces, dejan la tierra sin vida...
Lexdale Witch Trials#016.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#017.src: And here, we starve in isolation. My people are lost, as the very earth itself warps and shifts.
Lexdale Witch Trials#017.dst: Y aquí pasamos hambre, aislados. Mi pueblo está perdido, pues la tierra misma se retuerce y se mueve.
Lexdale Witch Trials#017.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#018.src: The water, stagnant and gray. Nothing but those horrid magic scourges, and the worms themselves to sustain ourselves.
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.dst: El agua, estancada y gris. Nada con que sustentarnos salvo esas horribles plagas mágicas y los propios gusanos.
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#019.src: We cannot escape, for the sun scourges us. There is no place to go, no place to burrow that they do not wait.
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.dst: No podemos huir, el sol nos abrasa. No hay lugar al que ir, ni galería que cavar donde no aguarden.
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#020.src: You... You... You have life. You have a heart, and muscle, and meat... To survive till this torture ends...
Lexdale Witch Trials#020.dst: Tú... Tú... Tú tienes vida. Corazón, y músculo, y carne... Para aguantar hasta que acabe este tormento...
Lexdale Witch Trials#020.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#022.dst: Derrota al Jefe de los Moradores del Túnel.

Lexdale Witch Trials#023.src: Wait... These earthquakes! IT'S THEM! AGHHHHHHHHHHH!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#023.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#024.src: Dig yourself out of the dirt. Then go after the creature.
Lexdale Witch Trials#024.dst: Cava para salir de la tierra. Luego ve tras la criatura.

Lexdale Witch Trials#025.src: Return to {p} and try to show the mayor the creature at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#025.dst: Vuelve a {p} e intenta enseñarle la criatura al alcalde en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#026.src: You're back. Did- Wait, what in the nine hells is THAT?!
Lexdale Witch Trials#026.dst: Has vuelto. ¿Has-? Espera, ¿qué diablos es ESO?!
Lexdale Witch Trials#026.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#027.src: That! That was the thing in my basement!! I knew that human could find it! Thank you!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#027.dst: ¡Eso! ¡¡Eso era lo que había en mi sótano!! ¡Sabía que ese humano lo encontraría! ¡¡Gracias!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#027.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#028.src: That thing was spreading the decay through my house! It's NOT witches or magic like you suddenly DECIDED one day!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#028.dst: ¡Esa cosa extendía la decadencia por mi casa! ¡¡NO son brujas ni magia, como DECIDISTE de golpe un buen día!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#028.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#029.src: ...Fine then. This... creature... bug... leach? This whatever- it- is... I'll accept your explanation.
Lexdale Witch Trials#029.dst: ...Está bien. Esta... criatura... bicho... ¿sanguijuela? Esta cosa- sea- lo que sea... Acepto su explicación.
Lexdale Witch Trials#029.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#030.src: Step off the podium, Ms. Amira. You're innocent.
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.dst: Baje del estrado, señora Amira. Es inocente.
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#031.src: Gah, finally! You're seeing sense! It's almost like something just... took you over one day and never left 'til now!
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.dst: ¡Bah, por fin! ¡Entras en razón! Es casi como si algo... se apoderara de ti un día y no se fuera hasta ahora.
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#032.src: ...hm. That... Mmh. Regardless. Human, you've proven yourself to be trustworthy. We'll keep our doors open for you.
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.dst: ...hum. Eso... Mmh. En fin. Humano, has demostrado ser de fiar. Nuestras puertas seguirán abiertas para ti.
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#033.src: As for the... THING... Well... I'll be sure to inform the Gavel government.
Lexdale Witch Trials#033.dst: En cuanto a esa... COSA... En fin... Informaré al gobierno de Gavel.
Lexdale Witch Trials#033.speaker: The Mayor
